rules: Visible pixels remain at their original integer coordinates with no scaling or regeneration.
A pixel may have one semantic owner in the four-material validation set.
Hidden completion is recorded separately from visible ownership.
Default occlusion never counts as proof that a hidden seam is complete.

owns: screen-right T-shirt sleeve fabric, outline, shading, and sleeve hem
doesNotOwn: torso fabric outside the sleeve semantic boundary
hair pixels crossing the shoulder area
hiddenResponsibility: enough inner sleeve continuation to cover the shoulder rotation range

owns: skin from the screen-right sleeve exit to the elbow ownership boundary
doesNotOwn: forearm skin beyond the elbow ownership boundary
hiddenResponsibility: skin and contour continuation under the sleeve
elbow overlap required by all sampled transforms

owns: skin from the elbow ownership boundary to the wrist ownership boundary
doesNotOwn: hand pixels beyond the wrist ownership boundary
hiddenResponsibility: continuous wrist material beneath the bracelet evaluation mask

owns: palm and all visible fingers as one rigid semantic material
doesNotOwn: forearm skin proximal to the wrist boundary
hiddenResponsibility: wrist-root continuation needed by all sampled transforms
